info.title: WaveMP API
info.description: REST API of WaveMP, a nostalgic media player.

get.summary: Lists the albums, sorted and optionally searched and filtered.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort key; Artist by default, Relevance with q. Relevance without q falls back to the default.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Sort direction; descending by default for FirstSeenAt and Relevance, otherwise ascending.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text: only albums whose title or album artist contains it or is similar to it (small typos).

parameters.name: artistId
parameters.description: Only albums with this album artist or with tracks of this artist.

parameters.name: genre
parameters.description: Only albums with tracks of this genre, without regard to case.

parameters.name: myMusic

parameters.name: sourceId
parameters.description: Only albums with tracks of this media source.

get.summary: Lists the groups of the album list (ListAlbums) with the same sort order, search and filters: sorted by Artist, runs of albums of the same album artist (kind Artist, albums without album artist as kind Unknown); sorted by Title, runs of the same index letter of the title (kind Letter); sorted by Year, runs of the same year (kind Year, albums without year as kind Unknown). FirstSeenAt and Relevance have no groups (an empty page). The position of a group is the offset of ListAlbums at which it starts. Offset and limit page the groups.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of groups of the page.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort key of the album list; Artist by default, Relevance with q.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Sort direction of the album list, defaults as in ListAlbums.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text of the album list.

parameters.name: artistId
parameters.description: Only albums with this album artist or with tracks of this artist.

parameters.name: genre
parameters.description: Only albums with tracks of this genre, without regard to case.

parameters.name: myMusic
parameters.description: Only albums with tracks of the "my music" of the current profile.

parameters.name: sourceId
parameters.description: Only albums with tracks of this media source.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of tracks of the page.

parameters.name: sort

parameters.name: direction

parameters.name: q

parameters.name: hasAudio
parameters.description: Only tracks with (true) or without (false) an audio file.

parameters.name: hasVideo

404.description: The album does not exist (code `album.not_found`).

get.summary: Returns the cover of an album as picture: its own cover (its online cover, the picture in its folder, otherwise a picture embedded in one of its tracks); without one, the picture of its album artist if the rule of the album allows it (GetAlbumCoverFallback), never the cover of another album or a picture with the name of a song. With size, the picture is scaled to fit into a square of 96, 192, 300, 600, 1000 or 2000 pixels (the requested size rounded up, at most 2000; never enlarged) and delivered as WebP from the cache; without size, as stored (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF or BMP). Every picture carries a strong ETag of its version and size, Last-Modified and Cache-Control: private, no-cache; a request with a matching If-None-Match returns 304.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Largest width and height in pixels the client shows the picture with (1 to 4096), its width in CSS pixels times the pixel density of the screen; the server rounds it up to 96, 192, 300, 600, 1000 or 2000.

404.description: The album does not exist (code `album.not_found`) or has no cover (code `cover.not_found`).

get.summary: Searches MusicBrainz for artists with the name of the artist, the most relevant first. Requests to MusicBrainz wait in the queue that keeps the shortest time between two of them. The artist name is sent to MusicBrainz.

200.description: The matches; empty if MusicBrainz knows none. isRemembered marks the MusicBrainz artist an admin chose before.

404.description: The artist does not exist (code `artist.not_found`).

409.description: The online lookup is switched off (code `artist.picture_lookup_disabled`).

502.description: MusicBrainz cannot be reached or failed (code `artist.picture_lookup_unavailable`).

get.summary: Looks up the pictures of a MusicBrainz artist: on Wikimedia Commons through its Wikidata item (without API key) and, if the admin entered an API key, on fanart.tv. The MusicBrainz id is sent to MusicBrainz, Wikidata and fanart.tv, the file names to Wikimedia Commons. Nothing is written to the artist; the MusicBrainz artist is remembered only when a picture is taken over.

parameters.name: musicBrainzArtistId
parameters.description: The MusicBrainz artist; the one an admin chose before if missing.

200.description: The pictures, those of Wikimedia Commons first, then those of fanart.tv by likes; empty if the services have none.

400.description: No musicBrainzArtistId and none remembered (code `request.invalid`, `musicBrainzArtistId`: `required`) or invalid offset or limit.

404.description: The artist does not exist (code `artist.not_found`).

409.description: The online lookup is switched off (code `artist.picture_lookup_disabled`).

502.description: The services cannot be reached or failed and no picture was found (code `artist.picture_lookup_unavailable`).

503.description: The cache cannot be written (code `service.unavailable`).

get.summary: Returns the preview of a candidate as WebP of 300 or 500 pixels (the requested size rounded up; 500 if missing), keeping its shape, so the admin can see and crop it before taking it over. The server downloads the picture once and keeps the preview in the cache; the browser never contacts the service.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Largest width and height in pixels the client shows the preview with (1 to 4096).

404.description: The artist does not exist (code `artist.not_found`) or the candidate does not exist, expired or belongs to another artist (code `artist.picture_candidate_not_found`).

409.description: The online lookup is switched off (code `artist.picture_lookup_disabled`).

502.description: The service cannot be reached or delivered no usable picture (code `artist.picture_lookup_unavailable`).

503.description: Pictures cannot be processed: ffmpeg is missing or the cache cannot be written (code `service.unavailable`).

put.summary: Takes a candidate over as the online picture of the artist: the server downloads the picture in full size (1280 pixels wide on Wikimedia Commons), checks that it is a JPEG, PNG or WebP picture, cuts the section out (the largest square in the middle without one), stores it as WebP in several sizes without its metadata together with its author, license and source, and remembers the MusicBrainz artist for the next lookup. Replaces an earlier online picture. It is shown unless there is a picture file in the artist folder or an uploaded picture.

200.description: The artist with its new online picture and its credit.

400.description: No or an invalid candidateId or a section out of range (code `request.invalid`).

404.description: The artist does not exist (code `artist.not_found`) or the candidate does not exist, expired or belongs to another artist (code `artist.picture_candidate_not_found`).

409.description: The online lookup is switched off (code `artist.picture_lookup_disabled`).

502.description: The service cannot be reached or delivered no usable picture (code `artist.picture_lookup_unavailable`).

503.description: Pictures cannot be processed: ffmpeg is missing or the data folder cannot be written (code `service.unavailable`).

get.summary: Returns the online picture of an artist, for admins only, also while another source hides it: square WebP of 96, 300 or 1000 pixels (the requested size rounded up; 1000 if missing), with ETag and 304 like GetArtistPicture.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Largest width and height in pixels the client shows the picture with (1 to 4096).

403.description: The profile of the session is not an admin.

404.description: The artist does not exist (code `artist.not_found`) or has no online picture (code `artist.picture_not_found`).

delete.summary: Removes the online picture of an artist with its credit, for admins only. Succeeds also without one.

204.description: The artist has no online picture.

403.description: The profile of the session is not an admin.

404.description: The artist does not exist (code `artist.not_found`).

get.summary: Returns the shown picture of an artist: the picture file in its folder, scaled to fit into a square of 96, 192, 300, 600, 1000 or 2000 pixels (the requested size rounded up; never enlarged; as stored if it cannot be scaled), otherwise the uploaded, otherwise the online picture as square WebP of 96, 300 or 1000 pixels. Every picture carries a strong ETag of its version and size, Last-Modified and Cache-Control: private, no-cache; a request with a matching If-None-Match returns 304. Artists without a picture of their own answer 404; clients show the collage of picture.albumIds instead.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Largest width and height in pixels the client shows the picture with (1 to 4096), its width in CSS pixels times the pixel density of the screen. 1000 if missing.

404.description: The artist does not exist (code `artist.not_found`) or has no picture of its own (code `artist.picture_not_found`).

get.summary: Returns the uploaded picture of an artist, for admins only, also while the picture file in the artist folder hides it: square WebP of 96, 300 or 1000 pixels (the requested size rounded up; 1000 if missing), with ETag and 304 like GetArtistPicture.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Largest width and height in pixels the client shows the picture with (1 to 4096).

403.description: The profile of the session is not an admin.

404.description: The artist does not exist (code `artist.not_found`) or has no uploaded picture (code `artist.picture_not_found`).

put.summary: Uploads a picture of an artist, for admins only: a JPEG, PNG or WebP picture in `file` (10 MiB at most by default), recognized by its content. The server cuts the largest square out of its middle, stores it as WebP in several sizes without its metadata and discards the uploaded file. Replaces an earlier uploaded picture. It is shown unless there is a picture file in the artist folder.

requestBody.description: A JPEG, PNG or WebP picture (10 MiB at most by default). The server cuts the largest square out of its middle, so clients that let the admin crop the picture upload the cropped square.

200.description: The artist with its new picture.

403.description: The profile of the session is not an admin.

404.description: The artist does not exist (code `artist.not_found`).

415.description: The picture is not a JPEG, PNG or WebP (code `artist.picture_unsupported_format`).

503.description: Pictures cannot be processed: ffmpeg is missing or the data folder cannot be written (code `service.unavailable`).

delete.summary: Removes the uploaded picture of an artist, for admins only. Succeeds also without one.

204.description: The artist has no uploaded picture.

403.description: The profile of the session is not an admin.

404.description: The artist does not exist (code `artist.not_found`).

post.summary: Chooses the songs that play after a list (album, playlist or queue), in random order: songs of the artists of the list, an artist that appears more often in the list more often; if they are not enough, songs of the same genres and similar decades. Songs of the list and excluded songs never come; songs the profile played within the last 24 hours only when no other song matches. Favorites and songs with 4 or 5 stars come a bit more often, songs with 1 star never; songs that only have a music video only while the profile includes them (setting autoplay.includeVideoOnly). Every song comes with its playback for the formats of the client, as GetTrackPlayback answers, including the signed stream URL. Clients call this when a list ends while repeat is off and the autoplay of the profile (setting autoplay.enabled) is on, and again for more songs; the endpoint itself does not check the setting.

requestBody.description: The list and the formats of the client.

200.description: The next songs; empty if no matching song is left.

400.description: The request is invalid (code `request.invalid`), e.g. no or more than 500 `trackIds` (`min_items`, `max_items`), more than 500 `excludedTrackIds`, a `count` out of range (`out_of_range`) or missing, too many or unknown `audioFormats`.

404.description: The profile was deleted in the meantime (code `user.not_found`).

404.description: There is no built-in avatar with this id (code `avatar.not_found`).

202.description: The run is queued; Location points to it.

Location.description: Address of the queued run, to follow its progress.

409.description: A backup is already queued or running (code `job.already_running`).

get.summary: Returns the cover rule of the songs of an album, the global rule it inherits and the priority that applies to its songs without a rule of their own.

200.description: The cover rule of the album.

404.description: The album does not exist (code `album.not_found`).

put.summary: Sets the cover rule of the songs of an album; it applies to its songs without a rule of their own, not to the cover of the album itself (see SetAlbumCoverFallback). Inherit follows the global rule again. A change starts the job cover-cache, which prepares the covers shown now; the cover URLs stay the same and deliver the new picture with a new ETag.

400.description: The rule is missing or unknown (code `request.invalid`, field `rule`).

404.description: The album does not exist (code `album.not_found`).

get.summary: Returns the cover an album shows, like GetAlbumCover: the rule of its songs does not change the cover of the album itself. Kept for clients that preview the rule; scaled as WebP with size, as stored without.

parameters.name: rule
parameters.description: The rule to preview; Inherit previews the global rule.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Largest width and height in pixels the client shows the picture with (1 to 4096), its width in CSS pixels times the pixel density of the screen; the server rounds it up to 96, 192, 300, 600, 1000 or 2000.

400.description: The rule is missing or unknown, or the size is invalid (code `request.invalid`).

404.description: The album does not exist (code `album.not_found`) or has no cover (code `cover.not_found`).

200.description: The cover rule of the track.

404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`).

A change starts the job cover-cache, which prepares the covers shown now; the cover URLs stay the same and deliver the new picture with a new ETag.

400.description: The rule is missing or unknown (code `request.invalid`, field `rule`).

404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`).

parameters.name: rule
parameters.description: The rule to preview; Inherit previews the rule of its album.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Largest width and height in pixels the client shows the picture with (1 to 4096), its width in CSS pixels times the pixel density of the screen; the server rounds it up to 96, 192, 300, 600, 1000 or 2000.

400.description: The rule is missing or unknown, or the size is invalid (code `request.invalid`).

404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`) or has no cover (code `cover.not_found`).

put.summary: Sets what an album shows without a cover of its own: the picture of its album artist (ArtistPicture) or nothing (None); Inherit follows the global rule again. The cover URL of the album stays the same and delivers the new picture with a new ETag.

400.description: The rule is missing or unknown (code `request.invalid`, field `fallback`).

404.description: The album does not exist (code `album.not_found`).

post.summary: Issues a ticket that opens the real-time connection of the devices for the current session, valid for 60 seconds. Clients pass it in the query parameter `access_token` (never the session token) and fetch a new one for every connection attempt. The ticket is accepted by nothing but the connection of the devices; the connection stays open while the session is active. Clients that can send headers may open the connection with the session token in the header Authorization instead.

parameters.name: direction

parameters.name: q

get.summary: Returns the lyrics of a track from the source of the highest priority that has lyrics: the lyrics file, then downloaded lyrics stored in the database, then the tags. Synchronized lyrics carry the start of every line (and of every word for word-synchronized lyrics) in milliseconds; static lyrics have no times.

404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`) or has no lyrics (code `lyrics.not_found`).

post.summary: Downloads the lyrics of a track from LRCLIB, for admins only, and returns the lyrics the track has afterwards. LRCLIB is asked by title, artist, album and duration; synchronized lyrics are preferred. The lyrics are saved as lyrics file with the base name of the track if its folder is writable, otherwise in the database. Lyrics of the tags or the database are replaced; a lyrics file never is. Requests to LRCLIB are spaced, so the answer may take a moment.

200.description: The lyrics of the track after the download.

404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`), LRCLIB has no lyrics for it (code `lyrics.download_not_found`) or lists it as instrumental (code `lyrics.instrumental`).

409.description: The download is switched off in the library settings (code `lyrics.download_disabled`) or the track has a lyrics file (code `lyrics.file_exists`).

503.description: LRCLIB cannot be reached, e.g. without an internet connection (code `lyrics.service_unavailable`), or refuses requests for a while (code `lyrics.rate_limited`, with Retry-After if LRCLIB names a time).

get.summary: Returns the stored result of the last lookup of the lyrics of a track in LRCLIB, for admins only. The download job looks up a track whose lookup found no lyrics (not found or instrumental) again after a wait (configuration `Lyrics__LookUpAgainAfter`), or at once once the result is forgotten.

200.description: The result of the last lookup.

404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`) or has no stored result (code `lyrics.lookup_not_found`).

delete.summary: Forgets the stored result of the lookup of the lyrics of a track in LRCLIB if it found no lyrics (not found or instrumental), for admins only. The next run of the download job (`lyrics-download`) then looks the track up again at once instead of after the wait. Results that found lyrics are kept.

404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`) or has no stored result (code `lyrics.lookup_not_found`).

409.description: The lookup found lyrics or the track already had lyrics (code `lyrics.lookup_found_lyrics`).

get.summary: Returns how many tracks have a stored lookup that found no lyrics, and how long the download job waits before it looks them up again.

200.description: The numbers of the lookups without lyrics.

delete.summary: Forgets the stored lookups of all tracks that found no lyrics (not found or instrumental), so the next run of the download job looks these tracks up again at once. Results that found lyrics are kept, also lyrics stored in the database.

204.description: The lookups without lyrics are forgotten.

get.summary: Returns the settings of the current profile.

It is valid for some time plus the duration of the track and while the session is active; clients ask again for a new one when it has expired. The answer also carries the ReplayGain tags of the file. For a casting device (target Cast), the client sends the formats of the device; the URL then stays valid longer, and the answer adds a signed URL of the cover.

With audioFormats, it answers 406 instead of a file the client cannot play.

rating.description: Number of stars from 1 to 5; 0 removes the rating.

UpdateTrackRating.description: Rates a track for the current profile.

oneOf.description: Reviewed marks the track as reviewed by the current profile now; Unreviewed puts it back into the review inbox.

UpdateTrackReview.description: Sets the review status of a track.

trackIds.description: The tracks; unknown ids and duplicates are skipped.

oneOf.description: Reviewed marks the tracks as reviewed by the current profile now; Unreviewed puts them back into the review inbox.

UpdateTrackReviews.description: Sets the review status of several tracks at once.

offsetMilliseconds.description: Offset in milliseconds from -600000 to 600000: position of the video = position of the audio + offset. Positive if the music in the video starts later than in the audio file (for example after an intro), negative if it starts earlier; 0 removes the offset.

UpdateTrackVideoOffset.description: Sets the offset of the video against the audio of a track.

oneOf.description: Whether Intel Quick Sync is detected and used for videos.

maxParallelJobs.description: How many ffmpeg processes transcode at the same time.

maxVideoHeight.description: Largest height of transcoded videos in pixels: 480, 720, 1080, 1440 or 2160.

audioBitrateKbps.description: Bitrate of transcoded audio (AAC) in kbit/s: 128, 160, 192, 256 or 320.

UpdateTranscodingSettings.description: Changes the settings of the transcoding. Missing or null values stay unchanged. Running transcodes keep their settings; a change of the hardware acceleration starts a new detection.

name.description: New name; initials derived from the old name follow it.

initials.description: New initials, 1 to 3 characters; an empty string derives them from the name again.

oneOf.description: New role; the built-in admin profile always stays an admin.

UpdateUser.description: Changes a user (profile). Missing or null values stay unchanged.

language.description: Language of the user interface as BCP 47 language tag, e.g. "en", "de" or "pt-BR" (language, optional script, region and variants; no extensions). The server keeps any valid tag in the usual case of its subtags ("PT-br" becomes "pt-BR"); clients offer the languages they have translations for.

oneOf.description: Whether the players even out the volume with the ReplayGain tags.
What the Now Playing view shows.

sidebarCollapsed.description: Whether the sidebar of the desktop layout shows only its icons.

oneOf.description: Changes of the theme of the web app.
Changes of the equalizer.
Changes of the crossfade.
Changes of the sleep timer.
Changes of the autoplay.
Changes of the videos.
Changes of the visualization.

UpdateUserSettings.description: Changes the settings of the current profile. Missing or null values stay unchanged, also within the groups.

ambientMode.description: Whether videos show the ambient light in the free area around their picture.

UpdateVideoSettings.description: Changes the videos of the Now Playing view of the current profile. Missing or null values stay unchanged.

oneOf.description: The visualization. Another module than the current one forgets the preset and the color scheme, unless the request names them.

preset.description: Name of the chosen preset of the module, up to 200 characters; an empty string forgets it, so the player picks one.

autoChange.description: Whether the visualization changes its preset automatically; the seconds stay when it is turned off.

autoChangeSeconds.description: Seconds after which the visualization changes its preset, from 5 to 600.

oneOf.description: How much detail the visualization draws.

colorScheme.description: Id of the chosen color scheme of the module, up to 64 characters; an empty string forgets it, so the player shows the first color scheme of the module.

oneOf.description: How strongly the visualization moves and reacts.

milkdropSpeed.description: Speed of the Milkdrop presets in percent, from 10 to 100.

UpdateVisualizationSettings.description: Changes the visualization of the current profile. Missing or null values stay unchanged.

initials.description: Initials shown on the profile tile.

isBuiltIn.description: True for the built-in admin profile, which cannot be deleted and always stays an admin.

hasPin.description: True if the profile is protected by a PIN, which selecting it needs.

oneOf.description: The avatar of the profile; null without one, then clients show the initials on the color of the profile.

User.description: A user (profile) as managed by admins.

items.description: Items of the page, at most limit.

offset.description: Number of items skipped before this page.

limit.description: Maximum number of items of the page, as requested.

total.description: Number of items of the whole collection.

language.description: Language of the user interface as BCP 47 language tag, e.g. "en", "de" or "pt-BR"; "en" by default. A client without translations for the language shows English, or the language without its region if it has that (e.g. "de" for "de-AT").

replayGain.description: Whether the players even out the volume with the ReplayGain tags; Off by default.

playerViewMode.description: What the Now Playing view shows; Video by default. Clients keep the choice of the profile with it.

sidebarCollapsed.description: Whether the sidebar of the desktop layout shows only its icons; false (expanded) by default. Clients without a sidebar ignore it.

theme.description: Theme of the web app. Clients without themes ignore it.

autoplay.description: Autoplay at the end of a list.

video.description: Videos of the Now Playing view.

visualization.description: Visualization of the Now Playing view.

UserSort.description: Sort key of the user list; ties are sorted by id.

field.description: The field: the JSON name of a member of the body (nested members as `a.b`, entries of a list as `a[0]`) or the name of a query parameter. Empty for the body as a whole, e.g. a missing body or malformed JSON.

min.description: Lower limit for `min_length`, `min_items` and `out_of_range`; missing for other codes.

max.description: Upper limit for `max_length`, `max_items` and `out_of_range`; missing for other codes.

ValidationError.description: A rejected field of a request: where, why, and the limits that apply.

ValidationErrorCode.description: Machine-readable reason why a field of a request was rejected, part of every validation problem. Clients translate it; the parameters `min` and `max` of the error complete it where stated.

errors.description: The errors, at least one; a field can have more than one.

ValidationProblem.description: Problem Details (RFC 9457) of a request that failed validation (400, code `request.invalid`). Instead of texts, every error names its field and a machine-readable code with its limits; clients translate them.

ambientMode.description: Whether videos show the ambient light: soft light in the colors of the current picture in the free area around it; true by default. Clients that show videos without a free area around them ignore it.

VideoSettings.description: Videos of the Now Playing view of the current profile.

VisualizationIntensity.description: How strongly the visualizations move, react and change their brightness. Players also use Reduced while the device asks for reduced motion.

VisualizationModule.description: A visualization of the players: an engine that draws the music, with its own presets. Further modules may be added in later versions; clients fall back to their default for a module they do not know.

VisualizationQuality.description: How much detail the visualizations draw. Auto lets the player choose the level by the frame rate of the device.

module.description: The visualization; Milkdrop by default. The presets of A-Force and BlackCap are their modes, their colors are the color schemes (ColorScheme).

preset.description: Name of the preset of the module the profile chose last, or null to let the player pick one. The players know the presets of their modules; a name a player does not know is treated like null.

autoChange.description: Whether the visualization changes its preset automatically; true by default. Turning it off keeps the seconds.

autoChangeSeconds.description: Seconds after which the visualization changes its preset while the automatic change is on, from 5 to 600; 30 by default.

quality.description: How much detail the visualization draws; Auto by default, which lets the player choose the level by the frame rate of the device.

colorScheme.description: Id of the color scheme of the module the profile chose, separately from the preset, or null for the first color scheme of the module. The players know the color schemes of their modules; an id a player does not know is treated like null. Milkdrop has no color schemes.

intensity.description: How strongly the visualization moves and reacts; Normal by default. Players use Reduced while the device asks for reduced motion, whatever the profile chose.

milkdropSpeed.description: Speed of the Milkdrop presets in percent of their original speed at 60 frames a second, from 10 to 100; 50 by default.

VisualizationSettings.description: Visualization of the Now Playing view of the current profile.

albumCount.description: Albums with tracks of the year.

items.description: Items of the page, at most limit.

offset.description: Number of items skipped before this page.

limit.description: Maximum number of items of the page, as requested.

total.description: Number of items of the whole collection.

Bearer.description: Token of a session, created with POST /api/v1/sessions.

MediaSignature.description: Signed media URL for players that cannot send a token header. Use the URL as issued (for example streamUrl of GetTrackPlayback): its query carries uid, sid, exp and sig. It is only valid for one kind of media of one track, until it expires and while the session is active. The HLS playlists carry the same query in the URIs of their playlists and segments.
MediaSignature.name: sig
